facts.text: Defence Construction Canada issued an Advance Procurement Notice for a data centre in the National Capital Region (ref. WA257004_88262)
The planned data centre is 60 MW with an estimated cost of $1.5 billion to $1.85 billion
The contract is conditional on approval to proceed; DCC says there is no guarantee it will proceed
The contract carries security requirements, including facility security clearance
At 60 MW the facility meets Ottawa's 'hyperscale' threshold of at least 50 MW
Hydro Ottawa received 34 large-load requests in two years, about 60 per cent (653 MW) data-centre related, per CEO Bryce Conrad
The project has not been officially approved by government
No site, contract award, construction start or operating department has been published
DND referred questions to the CSE, which did not respond by deadline
A DND Data Centre roof replacement at 101 Goldenrod Driveway is a separate contract
FedDev's $500M Regional AI Initiative expansion and the 2024 ISED AI compute consultation do not mention the Ottawa data centre
The notice lists a one-time delivery date of 2027/02/01; no construction start or completion date is stated
A tender aggregator lists a Jan. 5, 2027 deadline for the APN
The APN is not a bid solicitation or request for proposals
No revised cost estimate has been published
Ottawa Sun, Urban Mag and CTV News Ottawa reported the project at $1.5 billion on Oct. 15
A Malayalam-language outlet gave the range as $1.5 billion to $1.8 billion (rounding)
No amendment or addendum to notice WA257004_88262 was found

missed.text: Stated purpose: to support 'operations, security, and technology modernization'
Scope includes design and construction plus a small office space and a shipping and receiving area
A construction listing records a bid date of Jan. 5, 2027 and a start date of Feb. 19, 2027
The project may include an Indigenous business participation component
Hydro Ottawa's data-centre load requests represent 86 per cent of the city's average system load
DCC published the Advance Procurement Notice on Oct. 7
